Position Summary

The Finance Department in the Kelley School of Business at Indiana
University Bloomington invites applicants for tenured/tenure-track
positions at the advanced assistant, associate, or full levels
beginning in fall 2027.

Basic Qualifications

A completed doctoral degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, or
related area is required. Candidates should also have a record of
high-quality publications and demonstrated teaching excellence.
Teaching requirements may include undergraduate, master’s, and
doctoral-level classes.

Department Contact for Questions

Those desiring further information on these positions may contact
the Department Chair, Finance Department, at KSBFIN@iu.edu.

Additional Qualifications

Salary and Rank

Special Instructions

Candidates who have completed or will complete their degree during
or after 2026 should not apply for this position and should instead
apply for the separate position titled “Assistant Professor in
Finance.”

Interested applicants should review position requirements and apply
at https://indiana.peopleadmin.com/postings/33951
. Those desiring further information on these positions may contact
the Department Chair, Finance Department, at KSBFIN@iu.edu .
Applications received by September 15, 2026, will be assured full
consideration, but applications will continue to be accepted until
the positions are filled.
Before a conditional offer of employment with tenure is finalized,
candidates will be asked to disclose any pending investigations or
previous findings of sexual or professional misconduct. They will
also be required to authorize an inquiry by Indiana University
Bloomington with all current and former employers along these
lines. The relevance of information disclosed or ascertained in the
context of this process to a candidate’s eligibility for hire will
be evaluated by Indiana University Bloomington on a case-by-case
basis. Applicants should be aware, however, that Indiana University
Bloomington takes the matters of sexual and professional misconduct
very seriously.
